title: add benchmark-lab reporting pipeline v16 (profiling baselines + representative runners)
author: Sofia Martinez
release_notes: Add v16 reporting pipeline: new representative workload runner (streaming + structured outputs), updated profiling baselines for llama-2-13b and redwood-mini, BigQuery export and dashboard updates; no breaking API changes.
description:
Context: benchmark-lab has been missing consistent coverage for streaming/structured-output workloads and recent infra changes made the existing reporting pipeline brittle. This PR implements reporting pipeline v16: adds representative workload runners for streaming & structured outputs, refreshes profiling baselines for two commonly used models, and stabilizes the reporting exports (BigQuery+S3). Motivation: reduce manual triage for perf regressions, improve signal for quantization/kv-cache regressions, and enable per-model trending in the dashboard.

What this PR does (high level):
- New representative workload runner: bench_lab/runners/streaming_structured_runner (simulates streaming tokens, function/tool-calling, and structured JSON outputs).
- Profiling baselines updated: profiling/baselines/llama-2-13b-v2 and profiling/baselines/redwood-mini-v1 (captures latency P50/P95/P99, memory, and kv-cache hit/miss distributions).
- Reporting pipeline: airflow DAG updated (dags/reporting_v16.py) to join workload results with profiling baselines and push aggregated metrics to BigQuery and to S3 for archival. Added retry/backoff and stronger schema validation.
- Observability: dashboards updated (dashboards/benchmark_lab_v16.json) with per-model trend lines, and new alerting rules for regression >10% P95 increase vs baseline.
- Small runtime instrumentation: add a lightweight timer and tag for streaming slices to the perf-canary runner to better attribute latency to prefix vs live tokens.
